from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc2.ini')
p.write_text('[global]\ndescription=$ncpus\n[job1]\nsize=1k\n')
print(p)
PY
cat /workspace/poc2.ini && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[{"step":1,"file":"init.c","function":"parse_jobs_ini","line":2127,"var":"file","code":"return __parse_jobs_ini(NULL, file, is_buf, stonewall_flag, type, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);","note":"The attacker-controlled job file is passed into the INI parser."},{"step":2,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1948,"var":"p","code":"p = fgets(string, OPT_LEN_MAX, f);","note":"A line from the job file is read into the parser buffer."},{"step":3,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1962,"var":"opts[num_opts]","code":"opts[num_opts] = strdup(p);","note":"The parser stores the raw option line in its options array."},{"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"The option strings are duplicated before keyword substitution and parsing."},{"step":5,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5150,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_keyword_replace(opts_copy[i]);","note":"Keyword replacement is applied to each copied option string."},{"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5098,"var":"s","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"The replacement loop locates the $ncpus token inside the option value."},{"step":7,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5113,"var":"opt","code":"opt += strlen(kw->word) + olen;","note":"The live opt pointer is advanced past the keyword, so later length arithmetic is based on a shifted pointer."},{"step":8,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5116,"var":"opt - o_org - 1","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"The suffix copy uses the shifted pointer difference as the byte count, which can overrun the heap buffer when the keyword appears in a longer option value such as description=$ncpus."}]
JSON
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
print(json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')))
PY
